Source: chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0026 1. Remark 1.18\group so3-isotropy

When $B=C=D$ at $t=0$, this symmetry persists. It follows that $\SU (2)$ remains round and shrinks at the rate $D(t)=D_0-4t$.
